candidates.description: This vector represents possessive particles, prepositions, and grammatical markers across various languages, particularly focusing on genitive constructions like Thai and Greek.
This feature vector represents common Thai consonant-vowel syllable clusters and phonetic components often associated with transliterated foreign words or native word roots.
This vector represents Thai vowel signs, dependent vowel markers, and common Thai character sub-components.
This vector represents characters of the Thai alphabet alongside the Thai alphabet-based 'Destination Thailand Visa' (DTV) designation.
This vector is related to the Thai consonant 'ว' (wo waen) and its common orthographic combinations.
This feature vector represents proper nouns and given names across multiple languages and writing systems.
This feature vector activates on tokens and sub-words related to the Thai language, mixed with various proper nouns and foreign prefixes.
This vector represents phonetic characters and letters with various diacritics used across different writing systems.
This vector activates for mixed-script name tokens, proper noun fragments, and short subwords across various languages.
This feature vector represents subword tokens and fragments commonly found in Thai script and proper noun name prefixes.
